title: Compliance does not require a password

report.title: {Items.Count} Windows compliance {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy does', 'policies do')} not require a password

messages.businessImpact: A Windows device with no sign-in protection can still be counted compliant and keep access wherever Conditional Access trusts compliance alone.
remediation: Enable Require a password to unlock mobile devices, or the Windows equivalent the policy exposes, on each listed policy.
messages.cannotSee: Asks == false so a platform that cannot express the setting is not accused. Settings Catalog compliance is unread. Password complexity and length are not judged here.
